job_description:
We are looking for a Customer Service Executive to assist customers and provide effective support for their questions and service requests.

The candidate should have strong communication, interpersonal, problem-solving, and customer-handling skills. Responsibilities include responding to customer inquiries, resolving customer issues, maintaining service records, documenting interactions, and providing accurate information.

The role requires good verbal and written communication, active listening, teamwork, time management, attention to detail, and organizational skills.

Knowledge of Microsoft Excel, Microsoft Office, data entry, documentation, email communication, and basic computer applications is preferred.

The candidate should be able to communicate professionally, understand customer requirements, coordinate with team members, maintain records, and provide timely solutions to customer problems.
